## Session Brief

* [G-F1: find a set on LHAPDF_DATA_PATH with no home directory](G-F1.md) - pdf_tiers needs the cache root only when the cache or download tier is reached; a CLI test with HOME and VIBEGRAPH_HOME unset pins it.
* [G-F2: generate on p p > t t~ j with a quark-only jet](G-F2.md) - Reproduce generate's refusal on the quark-jet ttx card, fix the member-resonance lookup in mixed-flavour groups, pin it with a test that fails before the fix, and check the events against integrate's per-subprocess split.
* [G-HY1: hygiene review of #87](G-HY1.md) - Review the lazy cache root, the mixed-flavour line mapping and the new CLI and banked tests for maintainability, test non-vacuity, visibility and reusable abstractions; findings before edits; fix with mutation evidence.
* [G-V1: the ttx MLM row's own events against MadEvent's](G-V1.md) - Generate the pp_to_ttx_0j1j_mlm row's own process, now possible, and gate its record against MadEvent's banked run_01 as population fractions; the first test that generates that row.

## Session Report

* [G-F1 report: a PDF set on the data path is found with no home directory](G-F1-report.md) - Tiers.cache_root is optional; the cache and download tiers refuse with a named NoCacheRoot error, and CLI tests run as a user with no home directory pin both outcomes.
* [G-F2 report: a quark line in a mixed-flavour group takes each member's quark](G-F2-report.md) - member_line_pdg assumed a group's members differ from the representative only by conjugation; a QCD group joins u and d. A line whose flavour a leg below it carries now takes the member's flavour of that leg. generate writes events on the quark-jet and the full-jet ttx cards, and the per-subprocess counts agree with separate integrations (chi2 3.90 / 7).
* [G-HY1 report: hygiene review of #87](G-HY1-report.md) - The carried-flavour test now kills first-wins and the antiparticle-leg shortcut; the cache-root variable is named in the library; pdf_tiers cannot fail and says so; one integrate-and-generate harness replaces three; the no-home CLI tests do not run on CI.
* [G-V1 report: the ttx MLM row's own events against MadEvent's run_01](G-V1-report.md) - vibegraph generates p p > t t~ @0 + p p > t t~ j @1 under the row's card; 18 weighted population shares against MadEvent's banked run_01 agree within |pull| 1.89 (five more seeds: 1.94), gated in the banked layer at 13 s. The c-member line change leaves the llj and ll_0j2j samples byte-identical.
